candidate: For each genuine HGS population, independently complete and exactly score up to the 24 best feasible proxy individuals, then retain the exact full-model elite across all three views.
control: The ordinary proxy-best individual returned by the same HGS run. No extra HGS search is performed.
gate: All completions must be feasible; exact archive selection can never worsen the same run's proxy best; and at least one of the nine paired runs must strictly improve after exact population re-ranking.
stop: If no paired run improves, stop population re-ranking as a performance component. Do not enlarge the archive or change cases to rescue it.
claim_boundary: Seen development cases and one seed only. This isolates population re-ranking, not a final algorithm.
